messages:
marie kloss: Planning an 8-week secondment to Berlin (2024-08-01 to 2024-09-25) to pair with the EU eng team. Quick checklist: 1) Is WFH stipend prorated for ~56 days? 2) Can corporate laptop be shipped to my temp address (VAT/customs)? 3) Any payroll/tax nexus risk for Redwood for ~8 weeks?
maya (people-ops): Thanks Marie 449 Please fill the Temporary Homebase form (https://intranet.redwood/work-remote). Short answers: stipend is prorated by calendar days; shipments should use our approved vendor where possible; payroll/legal will triage nexus once form is in.
marie kloss: Form submitted and temp address attached. Role while there: pairing, internal demos, one public meetup talk (no client meetings), no local recruiting.
sanjay (payroll): FYI: ~56 days is generally below residency thresholds (183 days) and low risk for payroll cutover in most EU countries. Meetup/public talk is unlikely to create employer obligations, but we'll run a nexus check after legal's advisory. Hold off on changing bank details.
nora (legal): Adding legal note: Germany typically uses 183-day residency, but permanent establishment triggers can be activity-dependent (invoices, hiring). Public meetups are low risk. We'll open a quick advisory with our tax counsel to confirm.
logistics: If you select "international ship" in the form we'll attempt vendor-managed import to reduce VAT. If vendor can't ship, request pre-approval for personal import expenses with receipts. Shipping ETA typically 7-10 business days.
maya (people-ops): Next steps: 1) legal opens advisory (nora) 2) payroll runs nexus check (sanjay) 3) logistics confirms shipping ETA. We'll update you here by EOD with the consolidated answer. If you need to book housing early DM me for a provisional note but it's at your own risk until payroll confirms.
marie kloss: Thanks all 44d I'll wait for the consolidated reply before signing any leases and will DM for a provisional note if needed.
